name: custom-difficulty-ui-smf
description: A fresh, native C++ implementation of the same idea as Custom Difficulty UI (Nexus 14362) - per-difficulty-level damage multipliers (damage to the player, damage by the player), plus per-difficulty regeneration control the original never had - with a real Apocrypha Menu Framework (AMF) settings page, ported from its original SkyUI MCM. No upstream source to fork (Papyrus/MCM only, no compiled plugin).
